traceability.notes: All acceptance criteria and technical requirements in docs/stories/010.2-DEV-MULTI-STORY-SUPPORT.story.md are implemented and verified by tests. The codebase provides robust parsing and format validation for @supports, deep requirement validation against specific story files with scoped IDs, and updates to require-story-annotation and require-req-annotation so that @supports satisfies both story and requirement presence checks while preserving full backward compatibility for @story/@req. Mixed usage of both styles in the same file/comment is supported and tested, and error messages clearly indicate which story path was used when requirements are missing. Dedicated tests reference this story file explicitly and all relevant suites pass, and user-facing migration documentation for @supports is present. Therefore, the story is fully implemented.
